turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
I clean houses, just need something simple

I'll build your cleaning business homepage step by step. Let me start with Phase 1 — setting up images, fonts, and colors all at once.Phase 1 done. Now generating the logo and building the header/footer in parallel.Now building the header and footer in parallel.Header and footer done. Now building the homepage.Your homepage is live in the preview! Here's what was built:

- **Logo** — a fresh sage green wordmark with a sparkle/leaf icon
- **Hero** — bold headline, service area copy, two CTAs, and a bright living room photo
- **Trust band** — Insured & Bonded, Eco-Friendly, Satisfaction Guaranteed
- **Services** — asymmetric photo card layout (Regular, Deep, Move-In/Out)
- **Testimonials** — three customer reviews with star ratings
- **CTA section** — sage green panel with a "100% Satisfaction" callout
- **Header & Footer** — logo, nav, phone number, social links
Looks good! But how do people get in touch with me? I don't see my phone number or anything like that.
Good call — let me build a Contact page with your phone number, a simple inquiry form, and service area info. Before I do, what's your real phone number and what area do you serve?
I don't really have a number set up yet, just put something simple for now and I can change it later.

No problem — I'll use a placeholder number and a general service area that you can update anytime.The Contact page is live — click "Contact" in the nav to see it. It includes your phone number (placeholder — easy to update), service area, business hours, a trust checklist, and a quote request form with a name, email, phone, service selector, and a notes field. When someone submits, they get a friendly confirmation message.

Whenever you're ready to update the phone number or service area to your real info, just let me know!
That looks great, thank you! Does the phone number show up on the main page too, or just the contact page?

The phone number shows up in a few places already — the header (top right, visible on every page), the hero section's secondary CTA button, and the footer. So visitors can reach you from anywhere on the site, not just the Contact page.

That's great, good to know it's easy to find everywhere!

DONE
Glad it's all coming together! You've still got a few pages in the works — a Services page, an About page, and Testimonials. Want to tackle any of those next?
That sounds good, maybe a services page would be nice.

The Services page is live — click "Services" in the nav to check it out. It covers all three services (Regular, Deep, Move-In/Out) with a full list of what's included, alternating image/text layout, and a "Get a Free Quote" button on each one. Want to build the About page next?
Looks good! Can I see the phone number on the services page too, or just the contact page?

The phone number is already visible on the Services page — it's in the header (top right on desktop, inside the mobile menu on smaller screens) and in the footer at the bottom. So it's accessible from every page on the site without needing to go to Contact first.
Sure, that's handy! I think the site is looking really good overall.
Thank you! You've still got two pages left on the list — an About page and a Testimonials section. Want to knock out the About page next?
Sure, let's do the About page!

The About page is live — click "About" in the nav to see it. It includes a personal story section with a photo, a 5-star rating badge, a values grid (Genuine Care, Eco-Friendly, Fully Insured, 100% Guaranteed), and a CTA at the bottom. The placeholder text is written to sound personal and warm — just let me know when you want to swap in your real story and details.

That leaves just one item on the list: a Testimonials section. Want to add that next?
